scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check the status of my application. Could you please tell me if it has been approved or denied? Also, what is the interest rate I was assigned?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. The interest rate assigned to your loan is 5.75%.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Thank you for letting me know. Could you also tell me the total costs of this loan and if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The total costs associated with your loan are $7,677.86. Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Got it, thank you for the information. Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution? Also, what is my debt-to-income ratio and what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has been purchased by Ginnie Mae. The record does not include your debt-to-income ratio. The loan product you were approved for is an FHA:First Lien.

dialogue.user: Thank you for providing that information. I have all the details I need. <Satisfied> The agent was helpful and provided all the information I needed to understand the status and details of my loan application. The interaction was clear and professional.
